set.g.coupleSub: People, pet, language, invite, sign out
faq.q9: How do I add several groceries at once?
faq.a9: In Groceries, type them separated by commas: «milk, bread, cheese» — each lands in its aisle. Things you buy often show up as buttons under the field.
faq.q10: How do I change the sections at the bottom?
faq.a10: Settings → Screens & navigation → Tab bar. Four sections fit at the bottom, the rest live in «More». You also pick the section the app opens with there.
faq.a11: Any lists of your own: packing, gifts, what to take on a picnic. There are templates, a random pick and «Remove ticked». A list can be shared or just yours.
faq.q12: How do I install the app on my phone?
faq.a12: Android: in Chrome, menu ⋮ → «Install app». iPhone: in Safari, «Share» → «Add to Home Screen». Then it opens without the browser and can send notifications.
faq.q25: Where are the tips for each screen?
faq.a25: The first time you open a screen it briefly shows what's where. To replay or switch them off: Settings → Data & help → Tour.
faq.q13: Which settings are shared and which are mine?
faq.a13: Yours only: theme and look, tab bar, the Today screen, language and notifications. Shared by the couple: mascot, flame, «Around the world», grocery categories, budget and the sites in «Watchlist».
faq.q14: Can I use it on my own?
faq.a14: Yes, everything works for one person too. Invite your partner any time — they'll see everything you've already added straight away.
faq.q15: What is the Telegram bot for?
faq.a15: The bot sends notifications to Telegram and saves links: forward it a link from a shop, YouTube or maps — it asks which section to put it in.
faq.a16: Settings → Notifications & links → Notifications → the Telegram block. The bot opens — tap «Start». If the app is open inside Telegram, it connects by itself.
faq.q17: How do I choose where notifications go?
faq.a17: Right there in «Notifications»: to the app, to Telegram or both. Each of you chooses separately.
faq.a18: A weekly marathon: every week, a new country. Do the three daily quests on every day you take part (at least four days a week) and you get that country's theme with its flag. An almost full month gives a postcard and a joker, weeks in a row give bonuses. You can leave, but the streak starts over.
faq.q19: Why did my XP stop growing today?
faq.a19: XP has a daily cap of 150. That way levels grow from regular days, not one big evening. Tomorrow everything counts again.
faq.a20: Through everyday things in the app: tasks, groceries, dates, trips, daily quests and more. Every item has its own condition, written on its card in the collection. Some items come only from «Around the world».
faq.a21: Optional: only couples who joined themselves are shown — the couple's name, level and XP, nothing personal. You can leave any time.
faq.q22: Can I switch the game off?
faq.a22: Yes: Settings → Game & rewards → Mascot & flame. Nothing is lost — switch it back on and it's all there.
faq.a23: On your phone and on a protected server. Only your couple has access — the server itself checks this, not just the app.
faq.q24: What if we change something at the same time?
faq.a24: Entries are saved one by one, so it usually all adds up. The couple's shared settings are saved as a whole: if you both change different shared settings in the same second, one change may be lost — just do it again.
guide.title: Tour
guide.sub: The big tour and tips for each screen
guide.fullSub: All the main features in a couple of minutes
guide.screensHint: Tap a screen — it opens and shows its tips. ✓ — already seen.
guide.resetDone: Tips will show again when you open the screens
coach.searchBody: This button searches everywhere at once: tasks, groceries, recipes, notes, trips. The 🔍 inside a section searches just that section.
coach.telegramBody: You can get notifications in Telegram and forward links to the bot — it puts them in the right section. Turn it on in Settings → Notifications & links.
coach.tipsBody: The first time you open any section, it briefly shows what's where. Replay or switch off: Settings → Data & help → Tour.
guide.today.introBody: Everything for today in one place: events, tasks, groceries, your statuses and the mascot. Open it in the morning.
guide.today.statsBody: How many events, tasks and groceries there are today.
guide.today.searchBody: Searches all sections at once: tasks, groceries, recipes, notes, trips.
guide.today.cardsBody: Trip, budget, music, «on this day» — the cards change with the situation. Which to show and in what order: Settings → Screens & navigation → Today screen.
guide.us.introBody: Everything about the two of you: flame, level, notes, dates, rituals and rewards.
guide.us.heroBody: Anything you do together counts the day. XP adds up and the level grows — no pressure, missed days are forgiven.
guide.us.tabsBody: «Together» — notes, dates and plans. «Ritual» — mascot, mood and daily quests. «Rewards» — medals, «Around the world» and the collection.
guide.calendar.introBody: Shared events, birthdays and tasks with a date. Google Calendar connects in Settings.
guide.calendar.gridBody: Tap a day — everything planned for it shows below.
guide.calendar.addBody: Add an event — your partner sees it right away.
guide.tasks.introBody: Shared and personal to-dos with dates and reminders.
guide.tasks.quickBody: Write it plainly: «call mum tomorrow at 6pm» — the date and time fill in by themselves.
guide.tasks.filterBody: All tasks, only yours or only shared ones.
guide.tasks.swipeBody: Swipe a task right — done, left — delete. Tap it for details.
guide.groceries.introBody: A shared shopping list: what one of you adds, the other sees in the shop.
guide.groceries.quickBody: Type with commas: «milk, bread, cheese» — each lands in its aisle.
guide.groceries.chipsBody: What you buy most often — one tap away.
guide.groceries.catsBody: Items are grouped by shop aisle. Aisles can be renamed and reordered in Settings.
guide.budget.introBody: Shared and personal spending, income, goals and who owes whom.
guide.budget.statsBody: The month's key numbers at a glance.
guide.budget.filterBody: All, only shared or only personal.
guide.budget.goalsBody: Savings for dreams: a holiday, a renovation, a gift. Top them up together.
guide.budget.addBody: Amount, category and who paid. Shared costs are split by your ratio, and the balance shows who owes whom.
guide.music.introBody: Share songs with each other: what you're listening to and what you recommend.
guide.music.quickBody: Find a song by name or paste a link to it.
guide.music.chipsBody: All songs, favourites or only from one of you.
guide.photos.introBody: The couple's shared album: trips, dates, everyday life.
guide.photos.addBody: You can pick several at once.
guide.photos.chipsBody: Tap an album to show only it.
guide.watch.introBody: A shared queue of films and shows: who suggested what and which episode you're on.
guide.watch.filterBody: The queue has three tabs. «Want» shows whose turn it is to choose.
guide.watch.pickBody: Can't decide? The app picks from your queue for you.
guide.watch.gridBody: Tap a poster: season, episode and where to watch — Netflix, YouTube and your own sites.
guide.wishlist.introBody: Wishes and gift ideas for each other.
guide.wishlist.filterBody: «Gifts» — things you'd like to get. «Dreams» — big goals.
guide.wishlist.gridBody: Preparing a gift from your partner's list? Mark it: your partner won't know, and you won't buy the same thing twice.
guide.wishlist.addBody: Paste a shop link — the name and picture fill in by themselves.
guide.recipes.chipsBody: Favourites, by meal, «someday» and your own tags.
guide.recipes.pickBody: Don't know what to cook? Spin the roulette.
guide.recipes.addBody: Paste a recipe link or write your own: ingredients, steps, difficulty.
guide.pet.introBody: Health, vaccines, weight and notes about your pet.
guide.pet.actionsBody: Vaccine, weight and profile in one tap. The app reminds you of the next vaccine in advance.
guide.pet.addBody: Vet visit, medicine, a purchase — it all stays in the history.
guide.home.introBody: Home chores and notes: cleaning, repairs, bills, codes and manuals.
guide.home.listBody: Tap an entry to open it; swipe to delete.
guide.home.addBody: Add a note or a home chore.
guide.travel.introBody: Whole trips: a day-by-day plan, packing, money and documents.
guide.travel.listBody: Inside a trip there are «Plan», «Packing», «Budget» and «Documents» tabs. While you're away, the flame is paused.
guide.travel.addBody: Where and when — the rest can come later.
guide.dates.introBody: Ideas for where to go together, and places you've already been.
guide.dates.filterBody: Switch between plans and places you've visited.
guide.dates.pickBody: Can't decide where to go? Spin the wheel.
guide.dates.addBody: Paste a maps link or just type the name.
guide.lists.introBody: Any lists of your own: packing, gifts, picnic. Shared or just yours.
guide.lists.addBody: Start from a template or from scratch. Inside: a random pick and «Remove ticked».
guide.inbox.introBody: Everything quick lands here: a thought, a link, a «don't forget». Sort it out later.
guide.inbox.quickBody: Write straight away, no need to pick a section.
guide.inbox.swipeBody: Tap an entry to open it; swipe left when you no longer need it.
guide.archive.introBody: Entries you don't need every day but don't want to delete.
guide.cycle.introBody: A private section — only you see it. Your partner sees only the days in the calendar.
guide.cycle.addBody: Add an entry — the app suggests the next dates.
guide.more.introBody: All the sections that aren't in the tab bar.
guide.more.tilesBody: Tap to open. Change the order: Settings → Screens & navigation → Sections.
guide.settings.introBody: Everything is split into seven categories — from looks to data.
guide.settings.searchBody: Don't remember where a setting is? Type a word — you'll find settings and answers to questions.
guide.settings.groupsBody: Each has its own items inside. Questions and answers are in «Data & help».
